C-52.IntentSummary: One clipboard/drop path resolver that opens folders as the workspace (replace) and Markdown files in tabs; File › Open from Clipboard (⌥⌘V) and welcome-screen ⌘V; folder drops fixed; MAS routes through the Open Folder panel. Implemented by a ZCode agent in a worktree, reviewed and gated by the orchestrator.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: See spec R-1..R-5 and its acceptance criteria.

T-001.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c52) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Rust: new src-tauri/src/m059_clipboard.rs (mt_read_clipboard_paths → { paths, text }: macOS NSPasteboard on the MAIN thread via run_on_main_thread + tokio oneshot — pasteboardItems public.file-url flavor + public.utf8-plain-text, the m032/m053 dispatch pattern per the C-51 T-008 AppKit lesson; Windows CF_HDROP via raw user32/kernel32 FFI, no new crates; Linux paths empty, text via the clipboard-manager plugin; pure helpers file_url_to_path/parse_file_urls/percent_decode/parse_cfhdrop_bytes/classify_path all unit-tested), m009_menu.rs adds File › «Open from Clipboard» (id file.open-from-clipboard, Alt+CmdOrCtrl+V, after Open Folder in taxonomy + native menu, taxonomy test added), m_v1_compat.rs mt_pick_folder grew the optional default_path (R-5 panel pre-pointing; mt_cmd_open_folder passes None), main.rs registers the module + command and logs the CHANGE_SUMMARY. Renderer: new util/clipboardPath.js (parseClipboardTextToPath — first line/quotes/~/file:// decode; isAbsolutePath; isEditableTarget; classifyStat; resolveClipboardTarget — pasteboard paths first then the parsed text; openMarkdownFileTab — the drop bridge's exact mt::open-new-tab payload) and util/clipboardOpen.js (openFromClipboard orchestrator: read command with webview-text fallback, folder → OPEN_FOLDER_AS_WORKSPACE, App Store mode → mt_pick_folder { defaultPath } then the store on confirm, .md → tab, nothing → the localized clipboardOpen info notification via the dynamic-imported service); store/project.js OPEN_FOLDER_AS_WORKSPACE implements D-1 replace (foreign roots CLOSE_PROJECT'd, then ADD_PROJECT + mt_walk_project; same-folder dedup surfaces «already open» without re-walking); commands/index.js + descriptions.js register file.open-from-clipboard (⌥⌘V) through the menu-bridge id path; components/recent/index.vue START_BLOCK_PASTE_OPEN owns plain ⌘V/Ctrl+V while mounted (alt/shift variants, non-v keys and input/textarea/select/contenteditable targets ignored; listener removed on unmount — the editor's paste is untouched, D-3); _shims/install-window-globals.js dropped FOLDERS now go through OPEN_FOLDER_AS_WORKSPACE (R-4; images/Markdown branches unchanged, the .md branch now shared with the resolver). Tests: Rust m059 (percent/URL/CF_HDROP/classify) + m009 (menu item + position); vitest tests/renderer/util/clipboard-path.test.js (parsing matrix, guard, classification, resolution order, tab emit incl. read-failure), tests/renderer/util/clipboard-open.test.js (folder/markdown/notification routing, app-store defaultPath + cancel, backend-missing fallback), tests/renderer/store/project-workspace.test.ts (replace semantics, dedup, empty arg), tests/renderer/components/recent-paste.test.js (⌘V wiring incl. editor-surface guard and unmount), tests/renderer/commands/open-from-clipboard.test.js (registry + menu-bridge dispatch); e2e tests/e2e/clipboard-open.spec.ts (chromium + the new webkit-clipboard playwright project): text path and pasteboard list open the workspace (switcher + walk), replace records the close, .md opens a tab with content, garbage notifies, welcome ⌘V opens a folder and ⌥⌘V stays inert, dropped folder → workspace while dropped .md keeps the tab behaviour. Locales: menu.file.openFromClipboard + commands.file.openFromClipboard + the clipboardOpen notification in all ten static/locales/*.json — the orchestrator must regenerate *.min.json (locale tables changed). Graph: M-059 added (UTILITY, V-M-011 ref), M-009/M-011 summaries extended; verification: V-M-011 scenario-62 + ten C-52 markers. No files to delete. Gate-fix round 2026-10-17 (ZCode agent): the shim's openMarkdownFileTab edge became a DYNAMIC import inside the drop handler — the static edge pulled the shared renderer chunk (import-time window.electron.process readers, e.g. @/util/index.js) into the entry chunk, which evaluates before the shim installs window.electron, so the app failed to boot (every e2e red; pinned by new tests/renderer/_shims/install-window-globals.test.js); util/clipboardOpen now passes { filePaths: clip.paths, text: clip.text } to the resolver (the m059 { paths, text } shape was silently dropped, so Finder ⌘C never resolved); isEditableTarget also honours the contenteditable attribute + contentEditable property (jsdom has no isContentEditable semantics); resolveClipboardTarget catches a rejecting stat for injected deps too; graph M-059 listed in graph/index.xml with VerificationRef V-M-059 (new verification entry + index listing); MODULE_MAPs of the three flagged test files corrected to the linter's local lists.
